about_the_game:
Keep Me Gifted – Start Your Own Shop, Package, Sell, and Grow

Keep Me Gifted, A fun, engaging and sometimes a little chaotic simulation experience is now available in early access

Start your journey with a small gift shop and grow your business step by step. In Keep Me Gifted, you begin by naming your store, stocking your shelves with charming items, setting prices, and serving customers. Your goal is to maximize customer satisfaction, increase sales, and build a successful business.

As you progress, you won’t just rely on walk-in customers—online orders will start rolling in. Every day, a delivery driver will come to collect your prepared packages, so timely and accurate packaging is key. Fast and correct packing, tailored to each order, can push your shop to the top.

Made a mistake while packing? No worries. You can open the box with a utility knife and fix the order before it’s too late.

Add some fun to your packages with stickers and decorations to bring a smile to your customers’ faces.

Customers can pay with either cash or card, but don’t forget to collect the payment and return the correct change. Even small mistakes can affect customer satisfaction.

The core of the game is to grow your shop using smart sales strategies, earn high ratings through positive customer reviews, and become a successful small business owner. With its fun packaging mechanics, business simulation elements, and daily tasks, Keep Me Gifted offers a delightful and rewarding experience.

Keep Me Gifted is both fun and strategic. Bring out your inner shopkeeper, break sales records, and build your very own gift shop empire.

short_description: In Keep Me Gifted you will make your career debut as a Gift Shop owner. Be ready to encounter unhinged characters and their requests, try to match those requests with your wrapping skills, manage your item stock, upgrade your shop, and increase your store's popularity. And stay gifted!
